Across the water, the child lifted a hand, as though answering an old promise.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一本尚未合拢的书。路灯把空荡的街道照成淡黄色，清洁工推着车，扫过昨夜留下的纸屑。早点铺亮起第一盏灯，蒸汽贴着玻璃慢慢升起。远处有货车驶过，声音低沉，很快又被寂静吞没。一扇高楼的窗还亮着，不知是谁未眠。天边渐渐泛白，鸟鸣试探着落在屋檐上，新的一天正在醒来。","w03":"- Recursion means solving a problem by using the same method on a smaller version of that problem.\n- Imagine opening a box, finding a smaller box inside, and opening that one the same way.\n- You need a stopping rule, like stopping when a box is empty, so you don’t keep going forever."}
